welcome.title: Welcome to inScript
welcome.body:
inScript is a Bible study workspace that runs in your browser. It offers 1,300+ translations in 1,100+ languages, with commentary, search, audio, and images.

Press → for the next step, ← to go back, and Esc to close the tour.

topbar.title: The toolbar
topbar.body: The top bar holds the menu, the back and forward buttons, the search box, and full screen. Everything below it is a panel.

mainmenu.title: The main menu
mainmenu.body: Click the logo or the menu button to open it. Use it to add panels and to open Settings, About, and this tour.

addwindow.title: Add a panel
addwindow.body: Click an entry to open a panel beside the current ones. Choose another translation, a commentary, a search, gospel parallels, a text comparison, statistics, images and video, or audio.

reference.title: The current passage
reference.body: Each Bible panel shows its passage at the top left. Click it to go somewhere else.

navigator.title: Go to a passage
navigator.body: Books are grouped by division, each in its own colour. Click a book to list its chapters. Type in the filter box to find a book, a chapter, or a named passage.

navigate.title: Panels move together
navigate.body: Selecting Genesis 1 moved both Bible panels. Linked panels share one location, so a translation, its commentary, and its audio stay on the same verse.

versions.title: Change translation
versions.body: Click ‹ or › to step through related editions without leaving the passage. Click the name to open the full list.

textchooser.title: Choose a translation
textchooser.body: The list holds 1,300+ translations in more than 1,100 languages, grouped by language with the ones you use most at the top. Type to filter by language name or abbreviation.

versioninfo.title: Translation details
versioninfo.body: Every translation lists its publisher, copyright, and description.

linked.title: Link and unlink panels
linked.body: Click the chain icon to stop a panel following the others. Click it again to relink.

layout.title: Resize and reorder
layout.body: Drag the divider to resize panels. Drag a panel header left or right to reorder them. Your panels and their contents return on your next visit.

search.title: Search or go to a reference
search.body: Type a reference such as <kbd>John 3:16</kbd> to go straight there. Type a word or phrase to search the current translation. Then choose one of the two suggestions.

searchresults.title: Search results
searchresults.body:
Results appear in context, grouped by book. The bar at the top shows where the matches fall. Click a result to send every linked panel to that verse.

This search covers the four Gospels. Limit any search to the books you choose.

commentary.title: Commentary
commentary.body: Read public domain commentaries from Matthew Henry, Jamieson-Fausset-Brown, Calvin, Barnes, Wesley, and others. The commentary follows the verse you are reading.

comparison.title: Compare translations
comparison.body: See one passage in two translations with the differences marked.

parallels.title: Gospel parallels
parallels.body: Read the same episode in each Gospel, arranged in columns.

statistics.title: Word statistics
statistics.body: See word frequencies and a word cloud for the text on screen.

media.title: Images and video
media.body: View artwork, photography, and film for the current passage, including the JESUS film and the LUMO Gospels.

audio.title: Audio
audio.body: Listen to audio Bibles in many languages. The text follows verse by verse as it is read.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Set the reading typeface and text size, change the interface language, and switch chapter and verse numbers, section headings, footnotes, words of Christ, and justified text on or off.

theme.title: Reading themes
theme.body: Choose Normal, Shiloh, Jabbok, or Gethsemane. Until you choose one, inScript follows your system setting.

deeplink.title: Share this workspace
deeplink.body: Copy this link to reopen the same panels, the same translations, and the same passage.

palette.title: Keyboard commands
palette.body: Press <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> or <kbd>⌘</kbd>+<kbd>K</kbd> to open the command palette. Type a reference to go there, or type <kbd>></kbd> to search commands for panels, themes, fonts, and toggles.

finish.title: Tour complete
finish.body: Open this tour again from the main menu, or press Ctrl+K and choose Guided Tour.
